explanation: The theorem is about the library's own definitions: KTheory.ProjectiveClass, ProjectiveClass.map, ProjectiveClass.of and ModuleCat.RightExtension.Obj. It says that the class of a finite projective right module, mapped along φ, equals the class of its scalar extension. The proof uses only library lemmas (lift_of_module, mapValue_*, of_eq_of_equiv, RightExtension.mapLinearEquiv). Mathlib has no K₀ group of projective classes in this form, so no Mathlib declaration could state this result. No searches were run; this verdict rests on that knowledge of Mathlib.
